job_details.title: Assistant Director Airline Supply Chain Operations

basic_info.name: International Air Transport Association (IATA)
industries: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage

locations.street_address: 33, Route de l'Aeroport PO Box 416, Genève, Genève 15 Aéroport, Geneva

content.description: Employment Type: Permanent Contract Duration: Why you will love working here At IATA, we represent over 350 airlines worldwide, striving to make aviation safer, smarter, more sustainable, and inclusive. • Our Values are not just words on a page - they are the energy behind everything we do: ONE IATA - We collaborate across teams, TRUSTED - We do the right thing, INNOVATIVE - We make tomorrow better, INCLUSIVE - We embrace diverse perspectives. • With over 30,000 courses available, we believe in continuous learning and support your growth in an ever-changing industry. • Diversity, equity, and inclusion are our priorities. We are certified by the Equal Salary Foundation, offering equal pay and family-friendly policies. • We encourage community involvement through volunteering and strive to make tomorrow better for aviation and our communities. We offer time off so you can support causes important to you. • We promote work-life balance with flexible work options, including remote and hybrid work, a generous 'work from abroad' policy, and you get your birthday off! About the team you are joining Led by the Head Aviation Supply Chain, the team is responsible for the development of Industry advocacy solutions, the roll-out of global standards policies and initiatives related to aircraft Technical Operations and Supply Chain. This is an expanding people management role involving high levels of cross-functional coordination with other members of the department. You will have opportunities to develop your profile and lead through different areas of expertise. All members of the team work with a multitude of internal and external stakeholders (such as the International Civil Aviation Organization) and other international actors of the industry. What your day would be like •Lead a team of Subject Matter Experts directly reporting to the role, as well as through indirect cross-reporting by other Senior Managers. •Develop Supply Chain operations and coordinate the department’s advocacy programs related to IATA’s Center of Excellence (CoE) in Supply chain, and in Technical Operations as required. •Steer advocacy operations and developments of the IATA MRO SmartHub platform for the benefit of all airline members, and in close coordination with other stakeholders within IATA. Coordinate platform development activities within and outside of the team. •Lead MRO incubator assessments to support airlines members needs supporting the emergence of more diversified and independent MRO programs from the industry. Develop specialised awareness guidance to support IATA members to more efficiently leverage OEM’s product support frameworks in airlines supply chain, and maintenance operations. •Coordinate supply chain programs across the team, including through contracts and innovation program developments (such as materials quarantine, Logistics advocacy solutions, and IATA Connect platform to more closely interact with airlines departments from supply chain, maintenance and engineering). •Provide senior expertise as required to ensure that our airlines members needs are represented across supply chain, sustainability, technical operations, and other data centric programs. •Lead on Industry workshops and conferences to represent the department’s programs, with airline members, and other actors of our eco-system (MROs, OEMs. Lessors, Parts Distributors, Design Organization Approvals, etc...). •Identify and drive new initiatives enhancing efficiency, and sustainability for the benefit of our airline members and the other areas of IATA (such as Training, Publications, Consultancy, Events, etc..). •Collaborate actively with our other team members to ensure continuous sharing of expertise and knowledge across the department. Train the other team members on your core expertise. This to also enable that certain Taskforce and other Working Groups activities may be delegated under your supervision to other team members. •Deputise for the Head Aviation Supply Chain on designated programs and administration activities to ensure an efficient running of the Supply Chain & Technical Operations areas, and through any new assignments which may subsequently arise. We would love to hear from you if -At least 15 years of relevant experience, including as a manager in an airline on engineering, procurement and contracts, vendors and/or materials management. -Ideally, a dual career experience complementing a previous airline role, from either a MRO organisation, an Original Equipment Manufacturer, a Leasing Company, etc. -A master’s or bachelor’s degree in a relevant field for this position. -A combination of strong analytical skills, with a strategic mindset. Rigorous and disciplined approach to processes, contracts and strategic presentations. -Excellent interpersonal, verbal, presentations and written communications skills in English, with the ability to lead on Industry workshops and conferences to represent the department’s programs, with airlines members, and other Industry stakeholders of the eco-system. -An extensive team player with a well recognized growth mindset, strong cross-functional and collaborative approach, within and outside the department. Willingness to rotate your domain leadership with other areas of the department. Motivation to develop new fields of expertise from those other areas. In addition, a track record in several of the following domains would be also highly desirable: -Proficiency with regulatory frameworks from FAA / EASA Part 145, EASA Part 21, as well as with the use of aircraft maintenance documentation (MPD, AMM, CMMs..). -Familiarization with aircraft’ product support frameworks, as well as with aircraft and engines systems (e.g.: through General Familiarization Course certificates). -Experience authoring and negotiatingtechnical contracts. -Familiarity with SAP, and airlines’ Maintenance Information Systems (MIS). Travel Required: Y: 10% Learn more about IATA’s role in the industry, our benefits, and the team at iata/careers/. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

job_details.title: Senior Data Analyst w Benefit Systems International

basic_info.name: Senior Data Analyst w Benefit Systems International Praca hybrydowa Warszawa, mazowieckie Zobacz więcej

content.description: Miejsce pracy: Warszawa Na rozgrzewkę kilka pytań Nasze wymagania: Posiadasz wieloletnie doświadczenie na stanowisku samodzielnego analityka w obszarze analiz sprzedaży, zachowań klientów? Praca z bazami danych i zapytania SQL nie są Ci obce? Masz doświadczenie w pracy z narzędziami analitycznymi oraz ilościową analizą danych? Znasz narzędzia Business Intelligence – np. PowerBI? MS Excel nie ma przed Tobą tajemnic? Masz doświadczenie w budowaniu modeli danych i utrzymywaniu procesów ETL? Masz za sobą prezentacje dla współpracowników oraz kadry zarządzającej i potrafisz przedstawiać jasne rekomendacje oraz wnioski w oparciu o przeprowadzone analizy? Współpracujesz na co dzień w języku angielskim z różnymi działami w organizacji (np. dział sprzedaży, ekspansji, kontroling), zapewniając sprawny przepływ informacji i wsparcie analityczne? Tak – język angielski ze względu na międzynarodowe środowisko pracy jest konieczny. Masz doświadczenie w definiowaniu metryk (KPI) i wspieraniu biznesu w podejmowaniu kluczowych decyzji strategicznych w oparciu o dane? Kierujesz się zasadami fair play i win – win, a gra zespołowa to dla Ciebie czysta przyjemność? Sprawdź swój codzienny plan treningowy Opis zadań: Jako Senior Data Analyst w spółce Benefit Systems International z siedzibą w Warszawie (spółka należąca do grupy kapitałowej Benefit Systems S.A.) będziesz odpowiadać za przygotowywanie raportów i analiz na potrzeby zarządcze i operacyjne; Prognozowanie wskaźników biznesowych; Codzienna współpraca z biznesem; Wsparcie analityczne nowych i obecnych projektów prowadzonych w spółkach; Wizualizacja danych w narzędziu BI; Prowadzenie prezentacji i przedstawianie rekomendacji biznesowych po przeprowadzonych analizach. Na co dzień będziesz posługiwać się językiem angielskim Praca w Grupie Benefit Systems to sport drużynowy. Możesz liczyć na nasze wsparcie! To oferujemy: Czekamy na Ciebie z umową o pracę na zastępstwo, Pracujemy w modelu hybrydowym (6 dni pracy zdalnej/ms) z biura w Warszawie przy ul. Skierniewickiej (niedaleko stacji M2 Płocka), Jesteśmy różni i lubimy wstawać o rożnych porach - pracę zaczynamy między 8:00 a 9:00 i cenimy sobie work-life balance, Na większy głód mamy 30 minutowe przerwy, które wliczamy do czasu pracy. Korzystamy wtedy z karty lunchowej i lunchowni w biurze, Możesz rozwijać swoje umiejętności językowe. Do wyboru masz język angielski, niemiecki, hiszpański i włoski, Otrzymasz dodatkowe dni urlopu adekwatne do stażu pracy w Grupie Benefit Systems, Mamy dla Ciebie kartę MultiSport oraz możliwość zakupu karty dla Twoich najbliższych, Otrzymasz dostęp do platformy Multi.Life – znajdziesz tam ponad 4500 materiałów rozwojowych (kursy, e-booki), konsultacje ze specjalistami (m.in. psycholog, dietetyk, trener) oraz wsparcie AI w obszarach zdrowia, rozwoju, psychologii i odżywiania Możesz dołączyć do grupowego ubezpieczenia oraz skorzystać z prywatnej opieki medycznej, W trosce o Twój komfort i zdrowie, oferujemy dofinansowanie do okularów korekcyjnych, Dodatkowo o rozwój zawodowy i osobisty zadbamy poprzez szkolenia rozwojowe, Otrzymasz dostęp do programu kafeteryjnego MyBenefit z punktami, za które kupisz to czego Ci potrzeba oraz będziesz mieć możliwość zakupu tańszych biletów do kina i teatru, Na lepsze poznanie członków zespołu i budowanie relacji organizujemy spotkania integracyjne, Na wsparcie całego zespołu możesz liczyć nie tylko w okresie wdrożenia. Umowa o pracę? Możesz być o to spokojny. Urlop stażowy dodatkowe dni urlopu adekwatne do stażu pracy Początek pracy między 8 a 9 rano? Pewnie! Nie każdy jest rannym ptaszkiem. Luźny dress code? U nas nie musisz się spinać. Program wsparcia pracowników psychologiczny i managerski Karta MultiSport dla Ciebie i Osób Towarzyszących? Zdrowie Twoje i Twoich bliskich to nasza wspólna sprawa. Opieka zdrowotna i ubezpieczenie na życie? Zadbamy o Ciebie kompleksowo. Kafeteria MyBenefit samodzielnie wybierasz interesujące benefity Program lunchowy z aplikacją SmartLunch? Jakby inaczej! Lekcje angielskiego? Naturalnie, z platformą eTutor! Wsparcie całego zespołu nie tylko w okresie wdrożenia. Dofinansowanie do żłobka przedszkola lub wyprawka do szkoły, jeśli jesteś rodzicem Czas na Twój ruch! Jesteśmy Benefit Systems! Odpowiedzialność społeczna i zrównoważony rozwój, to nasze DNA i rdzeń działalności biznesowej. Chcemy być najlepsi dla świata. Z pasją tworzymy nasze programy dla tych, którzy chcą być aktywni i w pełni korzystać z życia. Dołączając do nas, staniesz się częścią globalnego ruchu B Corp, czyli spółek społecznie odpowiedzialnych. Przygotuj się na Zdrową Przygodę Życia!

We are certified by the Equal Salary Foundation, offering equal pay and family-friendly policies. • We encourage community involvement through volunteering and strive to make tomorrow better for aviation and our communities. We offer time off so you can support causes important to you. • We promote work-life balance with flexible work options, including remote and hybrid work, a generous 'work from abroad' policy, and you get your birthday off! About the team you are joining The P&S-BIS Passenger Traffic and Sales BI team manages a portfolio of Business Intelligence solutions for the travel industry, including Direct Data Solutions (DDS). DDS provides critical insights to airlines, airports, and travel agencies, supporting commercial performance, network planning, and revenue analytics. Reporting to the Senior Manager, DDS Data Ingestion, the Manager, DDS Data Quality will lead data quality initiatives across DDS products, ensuring data accuracy, governance, and operational excellence while supporting the continued growth of DDS solutions. What your day would be like The Manager, DDS Data Quality will be responsible for: Leading DDS data quality strategy, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives. Building strong relationships with airlines, system providers, and internal stakeholders to drive data quality outcomes. Managing airline data quality issues, escalations, and resolution activities, ensuring timely and effective communication. Defining and monitoring data quality KPIs, operational metrics, and service performance targets. Analyzing complex data quality issues, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective actions. Driving improvements in data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance across DDS products. Utilizing data quality tools, SQL, and Power BI to monitor performance, identify trends, and provide actionable insights. Supporting airline onboarding, implementation activities, and compliance with DDS standards. Managing quality reporting, dashboards, and executive level communications. Collaborating with Product, Operations, Commercial, and Technology teams to support strategic DDS initiatives and product enhancements. Representing DDS Data Quality in customer engagements, industry forums, and internal governance activities. Consolidated multiple airline engagement, case management, governance, and reporting responsibilities into broader leadership-focused statements. We would love to hear from you if University degree in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Business, Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in the airline, travel, or data analytics industry, with exposure to data quality, business intelligence, reporting, or commercial data. Strong understanding of airline sales, ticketing, distribution, or related data domains. Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, and cross functional teams to deliver business outcomes. Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to investigate and resolve complex data issues. Proficiency in SQL and data analysis tools, with experience working with large datasets. Experience using Power BI or similar reporting and visualization platforms. Knowledge of data governance, data quality frameworks, and reporting best practices. Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS) is an asset. Fluent written and spoken English. Travel Required: 10 Learn more about IATA’s role in the industry, our benefits, and the team at iata/careers/. We are looking forward to hearing from you!
